capabilities: Jump to the top or bottom of a note with floating buttons
Run the same jumps as commands or hotkeys
Place and style the buttons with presets and settings
Control scroll behavior and jumping back to the previous position
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-click way to jump to the top or bottom of a long note while reading or editing it.
summary: Navigation helper that adds floating jump-to-top and jump-to-bottom buttons to notes, with matching commands and hotkeys.
